name: AIS transponder and radar reflector (aids to navigation)
description: An AIS transponder and a passive radar reflector make an unmanned platform visible to shipping. They sit alongside lanterns and fog signals in the aids-to-navigation fit.

gaps.what: AIS type/power and radar-reflector radar cross-section
gaps.why: No page read gives the AIS class/power or a reflector RCS for a platform.
gaps.next_action: Fetch IALA guidance or an AtoN datasheet and record AIS type, power and reflector RCS

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
